thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate observed on /v1/generate and /v1/chat across us-west-2 starting 2026-03-16T16:12:00Z. Impact: Hosted API + Dedicated routing for a subset of enterprise accounts. Pager: @ryan_oncall
ryan_oncall: Ack. Investigating now. Marking P0, paging SRE. I’m pulling logs from the gateway and transformer pool.
ana_sre: seeing repeated 503 from transformer-0-*, error: "kv-cache miss + OOM during kv-attach" around 16:11-16:13 UTC. Queue depth jumped 4x.
priya_runtime: We just pushed batching optimization v0.12 to canary 16:09 UTC. Rolling back canary to v0.11 across the cluster now — starting orchestrated rollback on pool group alpha.
ryan_oncall: Good call, priya. Steps you want me to run?
priya_runtime: Please disable batching policy override for canary routes: `curl -X POST https://internal-api/route-configs/disable -d '{"policy":"canary-batching"}'` then `kubectl rollout restart ds/transformer-canary -n inference`.
ryan_oncall: Running disable now. `POST /route-configs/disable` returned 200. Restarting canary pods.
linda_acct: Heads-up — impacted enterprise accounts flagged by routing logs: PrismBridge (acct: PB-301), Sprintline Capital (SL-77), NewBridge Fintech (NB-12). They are on Dedicated and also hit hosted fallback. Who will draft customer-facing text?
ev an_cs: I can draft tailored notices. Need concise impact blurb + ETA for next update.
marcus_support: Also list of API keys with elevated errors: `key-PRISM-*`, `key-SL-BATCH-*`. CS will need contact routing to their TAMs.
ev an_cs: Draft snippet: "We are currently investigating increased 5xx errors affecting inference requests for select enterprise customers in US-West. Our engineers are rolling back a recent batching change and enabling fallback routing. We will provide an update within 30 minutes. For urgent account assistance, contact your TAM or reply to this thread."
linda_acct: That works. Please add tailored line for PrismBridge: "PrismBridge: we detected errors impacting generation latency for production traffic; mitigation started and a rollback to the previous model/batching configuration is in progress. We expect progressive recovery within 20-30m; we will follow up when all traffic has stabilized."
priya_runtime: Canary restarts succeeding, pods transitioning. Observability: request latency dropping after disabling policy but still some 503s from transformer-1 pool. Initiating controlled failover to fallback-model-shard cluster (fms-eu-west fallback route already warmed).
ryan_oncall: Running failover script (snippet):
```
./scripts/failover.sh --from transformer-1 --to fms-us-west-01 --grace 15
kubectl patch svc inference-gateway -p '{"spec":{"externalTrafficPolicy":"Local"}}'
```
Started failover at 16:24 UTC.
incident-bot: NOTE: Incident channel created and P0 status set. Pager escalation sequence invoked.
statusbot: Publishing status page update (draft): "We are investigating elevated error rates affecting inference requests in US-West. Engineers are rolling back a recent batching optimization and executing mitigations. Some enterprise customers may experience errors or increased latency. We will post updates every 30 minutes." Approve to post?
linda_acct: Approve. Add impacted customer callouts privately to customer comms, not status page.
ev an_cs: Posting targeted messages to PrismBridge and Sprintline TAMs now (DMs). Copy of message: "Hi — we’re actively mitigating an infrastructure issue causing 5xxs for your traffic. Rollback + failover underway. Expected recovery in 20–30m. We’ll provide a post-incident summary with root cause and credits if SLA impacted. —Evan (Redwood)"
priya_runtime: Failover to fms-us-west-01 completed, healthchecks green on 60s window. Error rate down from 6.2% -> 1.1% but still above norm. Continuing to drain canary and monitor KV cache rebuilds.
nana_sre: KV-cache warmup ongoing; retry storm artifacts observed. Adding temporary token bucket throttle on retry loop to limit amplification: `rate-limit 50r/s` on transformer pool.
ryan_oncall: Applying throttle, done. Observability shows reduced retries and p95 stable.
marcus_support: Notifying support rotation: @oncall-night shift (next) please pick up in 2h. Leaving handoff note in incident doc.
priya_runtime: Action items for post-incident: 1) Re-run canary test suite for batching v0.12 with increased timeouts, 2) Investigate KV attach path race causing OOM, 3) Add safety toggle to batching rollout docs, 4) Customer post-incident summary (acct owners + CS).
linda_acct: I’ll coordinate outreach and credits if SLA breach confirmed. Priya, add a one-paragraph timeline so CS can share with customers.
ev an_cs: First targeted updates sent to PrismBridge + Sprintline + NewBridge. Will update thread with any replies.
ryan_oncall: Current status: mitigations applied, failover successful, error rate decreasing. Next update in 20m or sooner on any regression. Handing off active watch to @ana_sre for next 45m then to night oncall.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations in place; severity downgraded to P1 monitoring at 16:42 UTC.
statusbot: Status page published.
marcus_support: Closing notes: save logs for 72h retention under incident/1799991110 and tag events so postmortem can reference exact rollouts and config patches.
ryan_oncall: Thanks team. If customer replies escalate to me and priya. I’ll prepare initial timeline for postmortem.
